subtitle.system: Installation information. These values are changed in the configuration file /etc/pkm/config.yaml.
subtitle.kubernetes: Connection to the Kubernetes cluster and metric sources.
subtitle.podman: Connection to the Podman API on this host.
subtitle.logging: Service log verbosity and log viewer limits.
subtitle.backup: Retention of Scarlet backups and of the audit log.
subtitle.auth: Session duration, lockout after failed attempts and password rules.

groupHelp.kubernetes: Scarlet uses a kubeconfig readable by the pkm service user (recommended: a dedicated ServiceAccount with minimal permissions).
groupHelp.monitoring: metrics-server provides current CPU and memory usage; Prometheus (optional) provides history, network and volume usage.
groupHelp.podman: Address of the Podman API socket. Warning: access to the rootful socket is equivalent to root access on the host.
groupHelp.logging: The level is applied immediately, without restart.
groupHelp.logs: Limits protecting the browser and the cluster when reading very large logs.
groupHelp.backup: The scheduled backup is run by the system timer pkm-backup.timer.
groupHelp.auth: Changes apply to new sessions and new sign-ins.

kubeconfig.label: kubeconfig path
kubeconfig.hint: Absolute path on the server, for example /etc/pkm/kubeconfig (mode 0640 root:pkm).

context.label: Context
context.hint: Empty = current context of the kubeconfig.

in_cluster.label: Scarlet runs inside the cluster (Pod service account)
in_cluster.hint: Use only when Scarlet runs as a Pod in Kubernetes.

cache_ttl_seconds.label: Read cache (seconds)
cache_ttl_seconds.hint: Avoids repeated requests to the API server; 0 disables the cache.

prometheus_url.label: Prometheus URL
prometheus_url.hint: For example http://prometheus.monitoring.svc:9090. Empty = Prometheus not used.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Problem detection interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.hint: How often Scarlet re-checks the cluster to update the Operations Center and notifications.

level.label: Log level
level.hint: DEBUG only for temporary troubleshooting: it produces a lot of output.

include_manifests.label: Include the Kubernetes manifests export
include_manifests.hint: YAML of application resources (no Secrets, no volume data). It is not a full cluster backup.

sourceHelp.file: Value from the configuration file (or default/environment variable)
sourceHelp.ui: Value set from this interface: it overrides the file

resetConsequence: Changes made from the interface are removed and the configuration file values apply again.
logFileAt: Service logs are in the journal (journalctl -u pkm) and in the file {{file}} (rotated).
logJournal: Service logs are in the systemd journal: journalctl -u pkm.

system.tlsWarning: Use HTTPS in production: credentials must not travel in clear text.
system.fileOnlyText: Listen address and port, TLS certificates, database path, mode (live/demo) and trusted proxies are changed in /etc/pkm/config.yaml (or with PKM_* variables) and require a restart: sudo systemctl restart pkm. Check first with: sudo pkm-admin check-config.
